Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy:
We were doing work in a remote location in El Dorado, Arkansas. It's a remote radio facility. 
There was an old fiber line that was going to be decommissioned by our telecom provider. We were moving over to fiber.
What we saw when we turned this facility on was that the router we used was flooding the rest of our network with data.
Once we were able to isolate that it was coming from El Dorado, we removed that system from the network, and everything came back online. 
We were able to open up the airspace.
Mike Pence says the "appeasement" of Iran was one of the reasons the GOP lost the midterm elections.

Mike Pence on Iran:
JD Vance is a good man, but Vice President Vance is wrong.
We didn't lose this midterm election because of the war.

Mike Pence:
I think part of the reason why voters were turned off was because, after seeing our military respond brilliantly in Operation Epic and the strike against Iran last year, for inexplicable reasons, we stopped after five weeks.
We sunk their navy, and we had complete air superiority, took down 15,000 military sites in Iran, then we paused and began to embrace the politics of appeasement.
شاسوار عەبدولواحید: بە 39 کورسییەوە داوای هەموو پۆستەکان دەکەن و خەڵک دەکەنە قوربانی.

Mike Pence on corruption in the Trump administration:
Family members of Cabinet officials, family members, and the president's first family themselves—it's just been troubling to the American people.
A billion-dollar increase in your net worth through cryptocurrency—it's astounding to Americans. And the fact that a large portion of the source of that, before the inauguration, came from foreign interests in the Arab world.
All of that, I'm just telling you, as I travel across the country, it has caused many of our most ardent supporters around the country, harkening back to that promise to drain the swamp, to have concerns.

Mike Pence:
The administration themselves, and I would assume the vice president himself, have taken the party in a direction far from the principles of American leadership in the world, limited government, and fiscal responsibility.
